compression: Concatenate chunks in manifest order to obtain a gzip-compressed POSIX tar archive.
transformations: Original companion XLSX and HTML bytes preserved unchanged.

Table arrays preserve row order, headers, original source row numbers, numeric precision and nulls. Recognized Excel dates converted using 1900 epoch to ISO dates; partial date strings remain unchanged.
Formula text, attributes and original caches retained separately; formulas are not recalculated.
History index is filtered from the regional CSV and overlaps companion histories. Do not sum those datasets.
Master Parameters and Read me are regional methodology, not country totals.
